name: Çaqqal nəfəsi
overview: The series follows Nargiz, a 33–35-year-old woman released from prison after serving time for murder. Before her imprisonment, she had a husband and an eight-year-old daughter, and throughout her sentence her husband stayed in close contact—until he suddenly disappeared just months before her release. Determined to uncover the truth, Nargiz begins searching for him with the help of her former cellmate, Gulara, a once-successful businesswoman whose life was ruined by a mysterious man known as “Doctor.” Bound by similar fates, the two women join forces to confront their pasts and uncover long-buried secrets.
